name: bluestep
description: BlueStep tooling for Claude Code — bluestep-tools for B6P component workspaces (spec-driven skills, b6p CLI integration, subagents, hooks, platform reference) and core-tools for every other repo (core rule set, /task, /plan, subagents).

plugins.name: bluestep-tools
plugins.description: Spec-driven BlueStep (B6P) development: /b6p-* platform CLI skills, the /spec-* workflow, BlueStep subagents, guardrail hooks, and an on-demand platform reference.

plugins.name: core-tools
